verdicts.note: Stillbirth rates after Quebec CHANGED its fetal-mortality definition. A definitional discontinuity, which is the cleanest available evidence on how much a reported loss rate is an artefact of its threshold.
Economic impact of resignation after miscarriage.
Perinatal mortality meta-analysis protocol, sub-Saharan Africa.
Birth intervals and perinatal mortality, Indonesia DHS. Spacing behaviour driving loss risk, and a perinatal composite as well.
PNAS: maternal cortisol and VERY early pregnancy loss, measured before clinical recognition. Both a stress-determinant estimate and a demonstration of the observation-window problem.
Trends in self-reported pregnancy loss among US women 1990-2011 across four NSFG rounds. A national loss TREND, which is scarce and is the series a decomposition needs.
Systematic review of globally reported causes of stillbirth.
Stillbirth rate and risk factors among 886,505 women, Indian Annual Health Survey.
Air pollution and spontaneous abortion, Nurses' Health Study II.
Verbal-autopsy stillbirth factors, Bihar.
Population-level miscarriage prevalence and predictors of a FIRST loss, rather than recurrent loss.
PFOA/PFOS serum levels and miscarriage in a highly exposed water-contamination population; cross-file B.6.
Grief trajectories after loss.
Cardiovascular disease after loss.
Educational inequality in stillbirth risk across four Nordic countries, 1981-2000.
Stillbirth outcome capture and misclassification in population surveys, EN-INDEPTH.

Time to pregnancy and live birth by the interval between an early loss and resuming attempts, from the EAGeR trial. The recovery-time parameter measured directly, which is what converts an accounting share into a net effect.
Inner-city stillbirth and early neonatal death determinants from routine data.
Endometrial immune profiling in recurrent loss.

157 surveys across 53 countries with explicit data-quality metrics and adjustment procedures for stillbirth under-reporting. The most systematic treatment of the bias Casterline identified, and the natural source for a correction factor.
Soluble Flt-1 as a miscarriage biomarker.
Stillbirth risk factors, Sana'a maternity hospital.
Burden of MISCLASSIFICATION of antepartum stillbirth across 12 Nepali hospitals, measured prospectively.
Paternal inflammatory arthritis and miscarriage risk; a paternal determinant, cross-file A.16.
Aboriginal and non-Aboriginal perinatal mortality disparity, Western Australia 1980-2015, with stillbirth and neonatal separated by gestational age.
Perinatal death audit, Papua New Guinea.
Cost-effectiveness of a quality-improvement programme.

Completed family size in a rural Basque community 1800-1969, across the demographic transition. Completed fertility over the FDT is exactly the chapter's outcome and period, but the abstract does not say whether fetal loss enters the analysis. Retrieve before routing.
Stillbirth and preterm birth rates, Da Nang, Vietnam.

Japan's missing third baby boom, analysed through the joint time trends of live births, STILLBIRTHS and induced abortions. A fertility-trend argument conducted in pregnancy-outcome accounting terms, and it puts Wall 4's two components side by side.
Urinary perchlorate, nitrate and thiocyanate and pregnancy loss.
Solomon Islands referral-hospital stillbirth incidence and causes.
Ethnographic study of the invisibility of pregnancy loss in Malawi.
Verbal and social autopsy of stillbirth and neonatal death, Tanzania.
Stillbirth factors in three Kabul facilities; conflict setting.
Intrauterine infection in the causes of perinatal death; small autopsy series.
Umbilical-cord abnormality prevention overview.
ANXA5/VEGFA variants in early loss.
Stillbirths in Istanbul examined through DEATH CERTIFICATES, with the point that stillbirth records are not kept systematically. A registration-quality study.
Endogenous risk factors for early loss; clinical review, weak venue.
Maternal-fetal interface mechanisms in unexplained recurrent loss.
Stillbirth rate estimates for 190 countries; the earliest of the global-estimate series.
LH hypersecretion spanning infertility and miscarriage; no abstract, margins not separated.
Every Newborn measurement-improvement roadmap for stillbirth and newborn coverage data.
JAMA: stillbirth against risk factors ascertainable at pregnancy confirmation, including the contribution to racial disparities.
Ten-year prospective study of HLA matching and fetal loss; companion to the Hutterite anchors.
Bern maternity hospital 1880-1900 and 1914-1922, including the stillbirth rate. An FDT-era historical series with individual-level records, in the period the chapter's FDT cell is scored on.
Fertility and reproductive history in anorexia nervosa; the nutrition/energy channel at the individual level.

Population Studies: Swiss general fertility rates 1871-2022 across the 1889-90, 1918-20, 1957 and COVID pandemics, with births falling six to nine months after each peak and MISCARRIAGE offered as the explanation. A repeated shock in one long series, and the closest thing the chapter has to a replication design.
